newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks seen opening up, closing higher.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks seen opening up, closing higher.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to rise at Monday's opening on fresh buying of blue chips before the June 13 1997/98 (July-June) budget, dealers said.
Investors think the budget will be good for business despite bad economic conditions, dealer Rony Byramjee said.

Blue chips such as Lever Bros, Pakistan State Oil and Engro Chemical have risen sharply in the past few sessions as investors built pre-budget positions, the dealer said, adding: "The index may rise 15 points today."
